title: 祭坛
text:
{char}第三次被送进来。这一带的废墟里有人拜神：碎骨堆成的祭坛、没干透的血。

拜对了神，神会在战斗里帮你；拜神要信物，供神要祭品。这一张图教你怎么和神打交道。

先往前走。

texts.en:
{char}, sent in for the third time. People worship gods in this stretch of the ruins: altars of shattered bone, blood not yet dry.

Pick the right god and it helps you in battle. Following a god takes an Anchor; feeding it takes Offerings. This map teaches you how to deal with the gods.

Move on ahead.
